blocks.title: he teaches cold calling to 1M people. his best post asked for a *comment*

blocks.caption: jeremy miner, october 2026. swipe for the numbers.

blocks.text:
jeremy miner is a sales trainer. his reels are about cold calling, objections and sounding different on the phone.

on october 4, he posted a carousel that starts with **"Comment COLD and I'll send you a masterclass"**.

groups.label: comments on his posts
groups.caption: about 39x his usual, public numbers read on october 10, 2026

blocks.text:
the guy who teaches you to call strangers gets his leads by letting them raise their hand first.

that's not a contradiction. it might be the smartest thing on his whole profile.

blocks.title: nobody wants your cold call. everybody wants a free *masterclass*

blocks.text: a comment is an invitation. **a cold call is an interruption.**

blocks.heading: but the comment is just the *start*

blocks.text:
622 people raised their hand. each of them gets a DM, and some of them reply.

that reply is where the sale really starts. a link with no follow up is just a very polite cold email.

list: one keyword and one free thing, in the first line of the caption.
deliver it in the DM right away, not tomorrow.
then ask one question about them, before you ever pitch a call.

blocks.text:
be honest in the comments, i think i already know your answer.

i built ManySetter, an AI setter for Manychat that picks up the conversation after the comment, one question at a time. not affiliated with jeremy.

**build your setter free, link in bio.**
